sources.snippet: Why is it beneficial to calculate the carbon emissions of my model? Training ML models is often energy-intensive and can produce a substantial carbon footprint, as described by Strubell et al.. It's therefore important to track and report the emissions of models to get a better idea of the environmental impacts of our field.
